name: BSMP
summary:
BSMP is an ambitious multilingual technical survival and roleplay series in Minecraft, founded and directed by itsbrauu. This project brings together creators from different regions to coexist in a persistent world where narrative and social interaction are the main drivers.

The series is defined by its evolving lore system, where each participant's decision affects the course of the story. With a focus on creating a diverse community, BSMP offers a cinematic experience that breaks language barriers, allowing roleplay, strategy, and diplomacy among players to build a unique and constantly expanding universe.
